actions.observed_before: The replay's cs.kaist.ac.kr navigation union shows an explicit undergraduate-admission link, 학부 입학 <https://cs.kaist.ac.kr/content?menu=40>. The baseline never opened it: it chose off-domain PDFs and course pages as programme pages, and its admission.kaist.ac.kr attempt was blocked by robots.txt.
actions.action: Open the department's undergraduate-admission page. Its navigation label names the requested degree level and admissions, and it may link to the official KAIST undergraduate admission route that robots.txt allows.

actions.observed_before: Step 1's page says KAIST undergraduates are admitted without a declared major (무학과) and choose a major such as computing in their second semester. It sends applicants to http://admission.kaist.ac.kr/undergraduate/. The baseline was refused twice as robots_disallowed on admission.kaist.ac.kr/intl-undergraduate/..., so I need to know which paths on that host are allowed before spending calls there.
actions.action: Fetch admission.kaist.ac.kr/robots.txt to see whether /undergraduate/ (Korean) or any international-undergraduate path is allowed, rather than hitting another refusal.
actions.outcome: robots_disallowed status=None final_url=https://admission.kaist.ac.kr/robots.txt error=robots.txt unreachable (ConnectTimeout); RFC 9309 treats the whole site as disallowed

actions.observed_before: Step 2: admission.kaist.ac.kr/robots.txt timed out (ConnectTimeout), so under RFC 9309 the whole admissions host counts as disallowed and cannot be read. The official route has to come from another kaist.ac.kr host, such as www.kaist.ac.kr, whose robots.txt is 'Allow: /' (r1).
actions.action: Run a domain-restricted search to find KAIST undergraduate admissions pages for fall 2027 hosted off admission.kaist.ac.kr, for example on www.kaist.ac.kr/en; this costs 0 Fetcher calls.

actions.observed_before: The step-3 search ranked https://www.kaist.ac.kr/en/html/admission/0201.html ('Admissions Information') first. It sits on www.kaist.ac.kr, whose robots.txt allows everything (r1), unlike the unreachable admission.kaist.ac.kr. The apply.kaist.ac.kr hits are login portals, which are not evidence.
actions.action: Open the English admissions information page on www.kaist.ac.kr to look for undergraduate international admission details (the fall 2027 timeline and requirements) or links to readable official pages.
